name: Rust
description: Rust dedicated server, vanilla or with the Oxide or Carbon mod framework. The game port is UDP and is 28015 by convention. The console and a clean shutdown go through RCON, so the server will not start until an RCON password is set. A new map is generated on the first start, which takes several minutes.
startup_command: stop_wrapper() { sleep 3; for p in /proc/[0-9]*/cmdline; do if grep -qa /wrapper/wrapper.js "${p}" 2>/dev/null; then p="${p#/proc/}"; kill "${p%/cmdline}" 2>/dev/null; fi; done; }; if [ -z "${RCON_PASS}" ]; then echo "[Atlas] Set the RCON Password variable, then start the server again. The console and a clean shutdown depend on it."; stop_wrapper; exit 1; fi; ./RustDedicated -batchmode +server.port {{SERVER_PORT}} +server.queryport {{QUERY_PORT}} +rcon.port {{RCON_PORT}} +rcon.web true +rcon.password "${RCON_PASS}" +app.port {{APP_PORT}} +server.identity "rust" +server.hostname "${SERVER_HOSTNAME}" +server.description "${DESCRIPTION}" +server.url "${SERVER_URL}" +server.headerimage "${SERVER_IMG}" +server.level "${LEVEL}" +server.worldsize {{WORLD_SIZE}} $( [ -n "${WORLD_SEED}" ] && printf '+server.seed %s' "${WORLD_SEED}" ) $( [ -n "${MAP_URL}" ] && printf '+server.levelurl %s' "${MAP_URL}" ) +server.maxplayers {{MAX_PLAYERS}} +server.saveinterval {{SAVEINTERVAL}} ${ADDITIONAL_ARGS}; RUST_EXIT=$?; stop_wrapper; ( exit "${RUST_EXIT}" )

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the server list.

variables.name: Description
variables.description: Text under the server name in the server list. Use \n for a new line.

variables.name: Website
variables.description: Address opened by the 'Visit Website' button.

variables.name: Header Image
variables.description: Address of the image shown at the top of the server listing (512x256).

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Most players that can be connected at once.

variables.name: Level
variables.description: Map type: Procedural Map, Barren, HapisIsland, SavasIsland or SavasIsland_koth.

variables.name: World Size
variables.description: Size of a procedural map (1000-6000). Larger maps need more memory.

variables.name: World Seed
variables.description: Seed of a procedural map. Leave empty to let the server use its default.

variables.name: Custom Map URL
variables.description: Direct download address of a custom map. It replaces the level, size and seed above.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Password for RCON, which the console and the stop button also use. Required: the server will not start without one. Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only.

variables.name: Mod Framework
variables.description: vanilla runs the unmodified server. oxide and carbon download the latest release of that framework on every start.

variables.name: Additional Arguments
variables.description: Extra startup parameters, for example '+server.tags weekly,vanilla'.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Steam app id of the dedicated server. The installer and the update check on start both use it.

variables.name: Automatic Updates
variables.description: Check Steam for a game update every time the server starts.
